# scamp_vault (Resource)

Manages a Secrets Vault: a secrets store on its own server. Put secrets in it with scamp_vault_secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scamp_vault" "corp" {
  name       = "corp"
  package    = "vt-100"
  grow_up_to = "vt-1000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the vault: 3 to 32 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter. Changing it replaces the vault and every secret in it.
- `package` (String) Package by slug or name: vt-100, vt-1000 or vt-10000. Changed in place; down only if the secrets and tokens fit.

### Optional

- `network_id` (String) UUID of the network, attached to a router. Without it the account's default network. Changing it replaces the vault and every secret in it.
- `grow_up_to` (String) A bigger package the vault moves up to by itself when it is full. Changed in place.

### Read-Only

- `host` (String) The vault's name in DNS.
- `id` (String) The vault's id.
- `ip` (String) Public address of the vault.
- `private_ip` (String) Address of the vault in its network.
- `root_token` (String, Sensitive) The vault's root token, for the vault API. Rotated in the panel, it is read again on the next refresh.
- `state` (String) creating, configuring, active or failed.
- `url` (String) https:// address of the vault API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import scamp_vault.corp 0a1b2c3d-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```
